# a bad port (10-13); a host name with a port next to an address (14), ignored by both; alone (15),
# the CLI resolves it and scans that port, while the web app, which matches by address, warns. 12:00
# on line 16 is a time of day, not a host and its port.
web16 203.0.113.10:9443
# 203.0.113.10 on another port (20) is another endpoint: no DUPLICATE_IP. Ansible INI: a port on the
# host pattern, the first token of a line with ansible_* variables or under a [group] header, is its
# SSH port, so the host stays on -p with a PARSE warning (24, 26, 27); on a later token (28) it is TLS.
web14.example.com:2222 ansible_host=203.0.113.24
[web]
